decision.matchmaking_reconcile_identity: eligibility + history_legal + rng_order + unreconciled = 3I pairing_schedule (5952 leftover punch rows)
decision.hp_flow_identity: post_hp = pre_hp - applied_to_seat; applied_fight = sum of seat HP losses

decision.hp_gap_reconcile_identity: accumulated_prior_hp + current_fight_hit + current_fight_damage_magnitude + hp_unreconciled = treatment_eliminated_earlier + control_opponent_eliminated_earlier

decision.row_elim_hp_identity: every 3K third-party row maps to one causal elimination event; that event's fight has post_hp<=0; post_hp = pre_hp - applied_to_seat
decision.row_damage_reconcile_identity: every 3M class-(3) first-split row maps to one paired fight; applied = pre_hp - post_hp; cf = winner tavern + survivor tier sum; five-way terms sum to the row applied difference
decision.paint_equation_identity: painted_pool = round(abstract_pool); per-body share = largest_remainder(recruit_raw / board_recruit_denom, painted_pool)
decision.paint_reconcile_identity: Σ body synthetic shares = painted_pool; nested allocation parts sum to treatment−control body synth
decision.nested_allocation_identity: delta_synth = pool_magnitude + weight_composition + timing_membership + integer_rounding + residual
decision.same_state_identity: (A) control post-play board painted by 2S largest-remainder on the implicit/on-body pool; (B) treatment post-play board keeps incumbent and incoming synth with no repaint
decision.play_pool_reconcile_identity: Σ body synthetic shares = painted_pool on CF-A and on treatment post-reallocation; sticky boards conserve implicit on-body pool
decision.nested_scale_sync_identity: subsequent_scaling = pre_sync_input_state + sync_timing_count + membership_allocation + rounding_residue + residual
decision.scale_flow_reconcile_identity: board increment = Σ body combat increments at each scale-sync; body increment from last-play synth to combat-start = Σ logged post-play scale-sync increments
decision.same_turn_sync_identity: syncs are matched by turn after the last open-slot play; extra or missing turns are timing/count; common-turn residual_add×share splits input vs membership vs rounding
decision.recommended_next_step: Same scale-sync inputs allocate differently because board membership differs, clearing ~70% of the 3Q subsequent-scaling leftover. Next hour: route to the open-slot lifecycle lane. Do not apply a scaling correction; do not rewrite 2Q; do not change `_hero_damage`; do not retune scaling constants; do not change recruit defaults; do not burn confirm.
